name: Seiyoku ga Tomaranai Goshujin-sama to Sannin no Maid-tachi
original_name: 性欲が止まらないご主人様と三人のメイドたち
source:
The first morning of summer break.
Makoto woke up and immediately realized something was wrong.
"Why won’t this boner go away!?"

Out of nowhere, a maid showed up and proceeded to drain him dry with her mouth…!?
After that, he was taken to his late grandfather’s estate, where he was told about the "power of the incubus"—a force so intense that losing control of it could turn someone into a total pervert.

He also learned about his grandfather’s will: "If any relative shows signs of this power, they are to become the successor of Ikuma Holdings."

And so, with the incubus power now awakened in him and his libido spiraling out of control, Makoto set out to fulfill his grandfather’s wishes. Together with three maids, he began a series of very hands-on training sessions to learn how to keep the incubus power in check.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1011718]getchu[/url]]
translation:
暑假的第一个早晨。
真琴醒了过来，立刻意识到事情有些不对劲。
“这个混蛋怎么还不走啊！”

突然出现一名女仆，用嘴将他吸干……！？
之后，他被带到已故祖父的庄园，在那里他被告知“梦魇的力量”——一种如此强大的力量，一旦失去控制，就会使人变成彻底的变态。

他还得知了祖父的遗嘱：“如果任何亲戚表现出这种力量的迹象，他们将成为生间控股的继承人。”

因此，随着他体内的梦魇力量被唤醒，他的性欲逐渐失控，诚开始着手实现他祖父的愿望。他和三名女仆一起开始了一系列非常实用的培训课程，以学习如何控制梦魇的力量。
